evidence: Independent read-only security review of the frozen candidate. Verified all 57 candidate-listed non-evidence files against declared SHA-256 hashes; all matched. Independently computed the tracked diff from baseline ea9a83e069f1be79c307fd8a9c4b9fca85977409 with git diff --binary --full-index --no-ext-diff; SHA-256 matched candidate tracked_diff_sha256 222485975962498081e60cfee41ca6ffe42a7ea2a0983ca86b8bd112391f4b95. Task and bundle metadata match. Credential-free local execution: validated localTestMode rejects Alpaca/OpenRouter credentials and requires loopback application/database hosts; main creates the local market stream only in local mode and uses a LocalAlpacaMarketTransport that returns an in-memory EventEmitter socket. The local socket factory validates a fixed feed URL and codec headers, but never constructs ws/WebSocket or opens a network connection. Its auth credentials are fixed non-provider simulation constants used only within this in-memory handshake and are not returned in snapshots. Account simulation injects a fetch implementation that has no delegation to global fetch, accepts only the fixed PAPER origin, exact allowlisted GET paths and no userinfo/hash; it maps harness responses to in-memory Response objects. Production account adapter remains fixed to Alpaca PAPER origin and GET-only, with no order-writing method. Mode is literal paper and assertPaperOnly remains enforced; API routes do not expose order-writing endpoints. Local HTTP controls are only mounted under validated loopback localTestMode and request body limit is 64 KiB; replay steps, event batches, trace/log pagination, account fixtures, and failure queues are bounded. Market events pass the bounded production decoder. Traces store route templates rather than request URLs, logs use fixed event names and selected fields, and error messages/provider details are reduced to fixed codes; captured simulated auth frames are not exposed by HTTP snapshots (only counts are exposed). Candidate-bound focused and restart check records are PASS. No material security issue identified. This review does not constitute live Alpaca qualification.
